# Humiliated Trump attempts damage control with altered photo of his embarrassing Xi welcome

## President Donald Trump appeared to post a digitally altered photo of his tarmac welcome of China's Xi Jinping to Truth Social Thursday

![](https://i2-prod.themirror.com/article2038254.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200f/4_7071d8c321e91d1a_1.jpg)

For instance, the picture of Trump saluting next to Xi included the text “Only Trump” with a 13-star circular seal in the background.

President Donald Trump posted what appears to be a digitally altered photo to his Truth Social on Thursday of his tarmac reception of Chinese President Xi Jinping.

The original photo was taken as Trump, [whose marriage to Melania Trump is at its lowest point due to a 'disturbing truth',](https://www.themirror.com/news/us-news/white-house-afraid-melania-trump-1949744) stood next to Xi during a U.S. military flyover on Wednesday, when they met on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews.

The initial image showed Trump, wearing a long black overcoat and black gloves, saluting next to Xi, who had his hands at his sides. It comes after [a lip reader spotted Trump's furious 5 words as he went into a meltdown at another pilot](https://www.themirror.com/news/us-news/lip-reader-reveals-trumps-brutal-2015136).

Further in the background were military personnel who flanked either side of the red carpet that was laid out for Xi’s Air China aircraft.

The image posted to Truth Social, however, appears to have some notable changes. For instance, the picture of Trump saluting next to Xi included the text “Only Trump” with a 13-star circular seal in the background. It also appears that one of Trump's gloves was digitally removed, and the soldiers in the background appear to be blurry, and distorted.

![It also appears that one of Trump's gloves was digitally removed](https://i2-prod.themirror.com/article2038254.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/4_7071d8c321e91d1a_1.jpg)

It also appears that one of Trump's gloves was digitally removedIt also appears that one of Trump's gloves was digitally removed

On Wednesday, Trump sparked backlash when TV viewers watched him appear to wince during the B1 flyover, while Xi maintained a neutral expression.

The now-viral video shows Trump, standing next to Xi, saluting as a military jet flies overhead and emits a loud sound.

The president can be seen visibly grimacing as the jets fly by, while XI remains stone-faced.

Xi and China’s first lady, Madame Peng, received a lavish welcome from the first family, as a red carpet was rolled out and a military band played as the couple descended from their aircraft.

![The original photo was taken as Trump stood next to Xi during a U.S. military flyover on Wednesday, when they met on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews.](https://i2-prod.themirror.com/article2038250.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_TOPSHOT-US-CHINA-DIPLOMACY-TRUMP-XI.jpg)
